failure: cto_planner subprocess failures completely invisible: check=False + capture_output=True + no returncode inspection
cause: subprocess.run(cto_planner, check=False, capture_output=True) discards all stdout/stderr. A CalledProcessError (e.g. mission not in H0/H1 backlog) exits code 1 but factoryd sees nothing. H1 refill silently fails.
evidence: factoryd.py:159-165 — check=False, return value discarded, capture_output=True
working_fix: Log a WARNING with returncode + stderr when non-zero. At minimum: result = subprocess.run(...); if result.returncode != 0: _log(f'CTO_PLANNER_WARN rc={result.returncode}: {result.stderr}')

failure: PSR API hallucination: probabilistic_sharpe_ratio() takes raw returns array, not scalars (SR, n, skew, kurt)
cause: Deep research spec stated PSR = P(SR* > SR_benchmark | SR_observed, n_obs, skew, kurt) with scalar inputs. Actual purgedcv 0.1.6 API: probabilistic_sharpe_ratio(returns, benchmark_skill) where returns is a raw array. Passing 5 scalars raises TypeError. Also: formula uses raw kurtosis (normal=3.0), NOT excess kurtosis — opposite of what the spec implied.
failed_attempts: spec test vector: SR=1.5, n=252 → PSR≈0.84 — WRONG, actual≈1.0 (Z=4.67)
working_fix: XR_EDGE_TEST_VECTORS.json now has verified test vector: SR=0.1, n=100, skew=0, raw_kurt=3 → PSR=0.8395. Use returns array input.
applies_to: XR05_OOS_VALIDATION and XR06_STATISTICAL_CONFIDENCE — must use XR_EDGE_TEST_VECTORS.json as ground truth
source: XR_EDGE_METHOD_RESEARCH_REPORT.md + verified against purgedcv 0.1.6 installed package

failure: DSR (Deflated Sharpe) inflated to ~0 when annualized var_sharpe passed without bars_per_year=252
cause: Passing annualized variance of Sharpe without bars_per_year parameter inflates deflated benchmark by sqrt(252), making DSR≈0 always. Not caught by unit tests if only positive Sharpe strategies are tested.
working_fix: Always pass bars_per_year=252 when computing DSR from daily returns. XR_EDGE_TEST_VECTORS.json has verified example.
regression_test: test_dsr_positive_strategy: known-good strategy must have DSR > 0
